name: agent-monitor
description: Classifies every tmux pane running an AI coding agent as working/waiting/done and shows it as a status dot on that window's own PROJECTS-pane row. Reads the app's own agent list from Settings → Agents, with zero-config detection from pane titles and Claude Code transcripts; installing the app's agent hooks there upgrades permission-prompt and done detection to the agent's own events, for every agent in that list rather than Claude Code alone.

agentMonitor.waitingThresholdSeconds.description: How long an agent's transcript can go unwritten before it's shown as waiting rather than working. Only used when no hook event is fresher (see the extension's README): a single tool call routinely runs longer than a few seconds without writing anything, so a short threshold reports a busy agent as waiting. Install the agent hooks from Settings → Agents for the exact answer instead of a timeout.
